title: Assembly: Endgame
summary: An accessible word-guessing game with live feedback for screen readers.
description: A word-guessing game in React 19. Each wrong guess removes a programming language from the board; the whole game is playable with a keyboard and a screen reader.
challenges: The game state (remaining languages, guesses, win and loss) changes on every key press and has to stay consistent.
Screen reader users needed to hear each guess and the final result without seeing the board.
The on-screen keyboard had to match the guess history at all times.
solutions: The game is split into small components (Status, LanguageChips, Keyboard), and each one renders a single part of the state.
An aria-live region announces each guess and the final result to screen readers.
The keyboard renders from the same game state as the status area, and react-confetti celebrates a win.
imageAlt: Three Assembly: Endgame screens showing the game board, a win state with confetti and a game-over state.
